helpQCommands: Which commands are there in the game?
helpQHide: My rank is embarrassing. How can I opt out?
helpPointsIntro: A new player starts with {start} points. Every kill gains you points depending on your victim's points and the weapon. Killing a stronger player gains you more than killing a weaker one, and weapons with a high modifier (e.g. the knife) gain more than ones with a low modifier.
helpPointsDeath: When you are killed, you lose as many points as your killer gains. This makes moving up easier, but staying at the top harder.
helpFormula: Points = rounded({k} × weapon modifier × victim's points ÷ killer's points), at least 1, at most {max}
helpHeadshot: Headshot: the bonus of the "Headshot" action, if the table below has one.
helpHeadshotBonus: Headshot: +{n} points, plus the bonus of the "Headshot" action, if the table below has one.
helpTeamkill: Team kill: −{n} points; the victim loses nothing.
helpSuicide: Suicide: −{n} points (not right after a team change).
helpPvp: Actions against a player (e.g. domination, revenge): you gain the bonus, the other player loses it.
helpStreak: Kill streaks: when a streak of at least 2 kills in one life ends, the bonus of the matching action (e.g. "Triple Kill") is given once.
helpWin: Round win: every player of the winning team gets the action's team bonus.
helpBots: Kills of or by bots don't change points, but they are counted.
helpWeaponsText: The weapon modifier decides how many points a kill with that weapon gains and a death by it costs. Higher modifiers gain more points. Modifiers generally range from 0.00 to 2.00.
helpCommandsIntro: Type the commands in chat with ! or / in front. Only you see the answer.
helpCmdRank: Your stats: rank, points, K:D, headshots, accuracy, time played, and this session
helpCmdNext: The next player above you and the points gap
helpCmdHide: Hide yourself from the ranking or show yourself again (at most every 10 seconds)
helpCmdSettings: Opens the settings menu at the left of the screen
helpCs2Commands: Counter-Strike 2: the commands work, but the game shows no answer (there is no plugin for it); look up your stats on this website.
helpHideText: Type !hideranking in the chat, or choose it in the !settings menu. Your stats are still counted, but you no longer appear in rankings, search and awards. Type it again to show up again. Your profile stays reachable by its link.
voiceUnavailable: The voice server cannot be reached right now.
voiceNamesHidden: The names of the people online are not shown.
weaponsTotal: From a total of {kills} kills with {hs} headshots
mapTotal: From a total of {kills} kills ({hidden} by hidden players) with {hs} headshots
heatHintDeaths: Where players died, from {deaths} deaths with a position.
heatHintKills: Where the killers stood, from {kills} kills with a position; white centre: headshot.
heatHint: Where players got kills ({kills} with a position; white centre: headshot) and where they died ({deaths}).
heatNone: No positions yet. The collector stores them for Source games (GoldSrc logs have none).
playerMapHintTop: The {n} best players of this list with a known location (city via GeoIP). Hover over a picture for details, click to open the profile.
playerMapServers: The hexagons are the game servers of this ranking (location via GeoIP); hover for name, address and map, click to open the server.

shareTextClan: Check out the clan {name} on {site}: {members} members.

seoDescription: Live statistics of our game servers: player rankings, awards, weapons, maps and who is playing right now.
apiIntro: Read-only JSON API of these statistics: no sign-in, 120 requests per minute per address. Every endpoint with parameters, example answers and ready-to-copy code for curl, PHP, Python and JavaScript. The machine-readable description:
apiNoScript: The interactive reference needs JavaScript; the OpenAPI description above works without it.
licIntro: gameWE is licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later. This page lists the software, data and graphics by others that we use, with their licenses.
licNpmIntro: Every npm package a production install of gameWE web contains, with version and license, generated from package-lock.json at every build.
eventsCapped: The list shows the newest {n} of {total} events; choose a type or a shorter period for the others.
hallOfFameLead: At every scheduled reset the best three players of the period are immortalised here, with the values they reached. Each place earns a star: gold for first, silver for second, bronze for third.
hofStarsTip: Hall of Fame: {gold}× gold, {silver}× silver, {bronze}× bronze
hofEmpty: No reset has been run yet. The best three players appear here after the first scheduled reset.
hofRankTip: Rank reached at the end of the period
hofPointsChart: Points of the top three per period

consent.title: Privacy settings
consent.text: This site only stores what it needs (your language and this choice). Maps and Steam profile pictures come from other providers, who then see your IP address. We load them only if you agree. You can change this at any time via "Cookie settings" at the bottom of every page.
consent.catNecessaryText: Your language, the live switches and this choice. Stored only in your browser.
consent.catMapsText: Map tiles for the player maps from OpenStreetMap, named in the privacy policy.
consent.catSteamText: Profile pictures of the players from Steam's image servers (Valve).
consent.error: Could not save. Please try again.
consent.mapBlocked: The map is loaded from {provider}. Your browser then sends your IP address to that provider.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: What this site stores, what it loads from other providers and what it does with your data.
privacy.operatorMissing: The operator has not entered their details yet.
privacy.consentIntro: Content from other providers is only loaded with your consent. You can give or withdraw it here at any time; the change applies from the next page view.
privacy.storageIntro: This site sets no tracking or advertising cookies. It only stores the following in your browser:
privacy.stConsent: Stores your choice in the privacy settings.
privacy.stLang: Stores the language you picked with a flag.
privacy.stLive: Remembers that you paused a live list.
privacy.st2fa: Second step of the administrator sign-in (TOTP).
privacy.stAdminTheme: Light or dark look of the admin area.
privacy.browserIntro: Your browser loads the following directly from other servers. They receive your IP address and the usual browser details.
privacy.operatorImages: Pictures set up by the operator
privacy.tpTiles: Map tiles of the player maps
privacy.tpOperatorImages: Logo or icons of this site, hosted elsewhere
privacy.dataBrowser: IP address, browser and device details, time, requested file
privacy.serverIntro: Our server fetches the following itself and shows the result. Your IP address is not passed on, so no consent is needed.
privacy.tpSteamApi: Names, profile picture addresses and VAC status of the players
privacy.tpDiscord: Name and number of people online of the Discord server
privacy.tpTeamspeak: Who is on the TeamSpeak server
privacy.tpGithub: Check for new gameWE versions (admin area)
privacy.logText: Every request to this site is written to the server's access log: IP address, time, requested address, status code, size, referring page and browser (user agent). The log serves to run the site securely and to find errors. How long it is kept depends on the operator's server.
privacy.statsText: The game servers report what happens in the game. This site shows player names, Steam IDs, statistics and the rough location (city and country from the IP address) of the players. IP addresses themselves are never shown publicly. Players can ask the operator to hide their profile.
privacy.rightsText: Under the GDPR you have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection, and you can withdraw a consent at any time with effect for the future. You can also complain to a data protection supervisory authority. Please contact the controller named above.
